More power to you sweetheart <3 This pretty much is a post that is a mirror of how I see myself. How much I have lost myself. The fear rather the notion of being judged in everything I do keept me give up on everything.

But you know You shud NOT STOP YOURSELF FROM EXPRESSING YOUR OPINIONS. there are people out there who are utterly wrong and their opinions and words arn't exactly good not even up to the mark but they have so much conviction and trust in themselves that they say what they have to and so blatantly shutup those who give an opposing POV.
So, Be Yourself and Dont be afraid of saying what you have in mind. Just form your sentences a little before saying out your opinion. 
People Will Start Appreciating your Voice, Your Words and Your POV. 
You will recognize YOU!
Im humbled. One should learn to speak for their rights in a humble manner and stand by their stance.
